topic.title: Agricultural Land Classification / Best and Most Versatile Land
topic.source_contract: site boundary, provisional mapping, detailed survey, climate, gradient, wetness, droughtiness, soil profile, grade and subgrade, BMV extent, consultation threshold, alternatives, soil management, reinstatement, decision, construction and post-work land-quality evidence

scope_guards: A provisional ALC map is not a field-scale grade determination.
Grade 3 mapping is not proof of subgrade 3a or 3b.
A desk study is not a detailed soil survey.
BMV presence is not by itself a planning refusal.
A soil management plan is not completed soil protection.
Temporary use is not assumed fully reversible.
Reinstatement is not verified without post-work survey evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact survey, decision and post-work land-quality evidence.
